title: Sustainable biodiesel production: catalyst-free palm fatty acid distillate conversion to methyl esters by using a superheated methanol vapor process
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01182E, Paper
Maharani Dewi Solikhah, Soni Solistia Wirawan, Anto Tri Sugiarto, Dyah Wulandani, Shoji Hagiwara, Tetsuya Araki, Hiroshi Nabetani, Yohanes Aris Purwanto
Palm fatty acid distillate is a low-cost, sustainable feedstock for biodiesel. A catalyst-free process using a packed bubble column reactor with superheated methanol vapour at atmospheric pressure achieved high conversion.
